note: A template is a named bundle of existing realm roles, with the home screen and menu for people who hold it. Applying a template changes the user's realm roles in Keycloak; every access check in the services is unchanged (the menu only hides what a role cannot use). Service roles (svc_*) can never be assigned from a template.

templates.name: Staff (referral coordinator)
templates.description: Gathers records, papers and medicines, sends referrals and test orders, takes in incoming referrals and assigns a doctor. Cannot request referrals or review medication flags.

templates.name: Doctor
templates.description: Requests referrals and tests, reviews medication flags and results, and sees and answers referrals assigned to them.

templates.name: Laboratory, radiology or ECG staff
templates.description: Confirms arriving patients, accepts or rejects test and scan orders, and reports results with images.

templates.name: Institution administrator
templates.description: Manages accounts and roles, signs doctors' keys, reviews records requests the institution's policy holds for staff, and reads the audit log. No clinical record access.

templates.name: Clinical rule reviewer
templates.description: Approves medication rules and medicine names, and sees the imported interaction data, label rules and AI model figures.
